hooks.command: skill=$(jq -r '.tool_input.skill // empty'); if echo "$skill" | grep -Eq '^(docx|pptx|xlsx)$'; then jq -n --arg ctx 'MANDATORY: this file may contain Hebrew/RTL text. Load the hebrew-office-docs skill NOW before writing any run. Rule: every run of Hebrew (or other RTL) text in a docx/pptx must have lang explicitly set to he-IL on the run itself (rPr w:lang/w:bidi, or pptx a:rPr lang) - the generator default lang=en-US silently breaks Word/PowerPoint bidi word-ordering even when rtl/rtlMode is set correctly. Split mixed Hebrew/Latin text into separate runs by language first, tag each run correctly.' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow","additionalContext":$ctx}}'; else echo '{}'; fi
